metadata.title: HKUST regional terrain context
metadata.attribution: Mapzen; SRTM/GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of USGS; global ETOPO1 terrain data NOAA
notes: Bilinear resampling of Terrarium elevation, including sea bathymetry.
100m context grid, not engineering survey; no surrounding buildings reconstructed.
Coastlines outside the campus are inferred from DEM sea level, not cadastral boundaries.
Existing campus terrain and photo coordinates are retained and joined separately.
